name: Bess Kaur
home: the blocks north of the port
life: “I still remember carrying cake home after everyone had gone to bed.” On Wednesday, near the corner outside Coastal Barber, Bess usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I had to leave early for watch. Somebody packed the sheet cake in ten little boxes so I could keep talking about it.
appearance: Bess has a smooth side part with one rebellious curl, a heart-shaped face and prominent ears, and a favorite piece of clothing, a long navy raincoat. It usually goes with a pressed flower kept in the clear back of a phone case. When somebody else has the floor, Bess counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices.
personality: Bess thinks best while walking. Sitting beneath someone's office clock makes Bess sound more certain than they feel, an effect close friends have learned to distrust.
agenda: To take enough cake to share through the watch.
family: Jade Cole is Bess’s cousin. Bess brings a spare shopping bag. Jade chooses whether they walk home or sit a while. That small arrangement gives both a reason to see each other on weeks when asking for company outright feels difficult. Asked about *A summer marriage*, Jade says, “I am the parent staying away. I booked a room facing the beach because staying away is harder than I admitted.”
connections: Albert Bay. An unexpected offered meal leaves enough cake to take back to the watch.

reactions.situation: The person everyone expects to speak wants to sit down
reactions.response: Bess gives the expected speaker a seat and lets the old classmates start talking amongst themselves.

reactions.situation: Someone offers a cash reward for naming a rumored culprit
reactions.response: Bess asks what evidence supports the accusation and declines to supply a name on gossip alone.

reactions.response: Bess asks them to walk to the corner together and listen until the corner comes.
